# KOV Career Agency

> Founder-led career agency with separate candidate-side career representation and company-side executive talent sourcing engagements.

KOV agrees scope, markets, deliverables, fees, approvals, and reporting before work begins. Hiring decisions remain with employers; search activity does not guarantee interviews, offers, placement, or timelines. Coverage and suitability are confirmed for each engagement.

## Core pages
- [Global Talent Sourcer & Reverse Recruiting | KOV Career Agency](https://www.kovcareeragency.org/): Premium career agency for senior executives. Reverse recruiting, hidden job leads, recruiter outreach, resume optimization, interview prep, and negotiation support. KOV places leaders into premium roles faster.
- [Career Services for Executives | Recruiting, Resume, Interview Prep | KOV](https://www.kovcareeragency.org/services.html): Executive career services including reverse recruiting, high-volume targeted applications, recruiter outreach, resume rewrite, LinkedIn optimization, interview coaching, and negotiation management for senior professionals.
- [Global Talent Sourcer | KOV Career Agency](https://www.kovcareeragency.org/global-talent-sourcer.html): Independent global talent sourcer for venture-backed startups, private equity firms, and international companies seeking senior executives across North America, Europe, and Asia.

- [Pricing for Executive Career Support | Message Daniel | KOV](https://www.kovcareeragency.org/pricing.html): Candidate registration is free. Employers pay $15/month for verified directory access. Premium reverse-recruiting candidates pay an agreed onboarding fee plus a monthly retainer. Employers pay an agreed success fee on placement with a 30-day placement warranty. Premium and placement fees are agreed in writing before work starts.

## Core services
- [Reverse Recruiting for Senior Professionals | KOV](https://www.kovcareeragency.org/services/reverse-recruiting.html): Private reverse recruiting for senior professionals: define a target, research roles, coordinate applications and outreach, and prepare for next steps.
- [Executive Search Support for Employers | KOV](https://www.kovcareeragency.org/services/executive-search-support.html): Research-led executive search support for employers who need a clear role brief, focused talent research, discreet outreach and structured updates.
- [Career Strategy for Senior Leaders | KOV](https://www.kovcareeragency.org/services/career-strategy-senior-leaders.html): Career strategy for senior leaders: clarify your next move, target roles and markets, executive positioning, and a practical search plan with KOV.
- [Executive Resume Strategy for Senior Leaders | KOV](https://www.kovcareeragency.org/services/executive-resume-strategy.html): Executive resume strategy that clarifies leadership scope, evidence-backed achievements and fit for target roles and markets.
- [Interview Coaching for Executives | KOV](https://www.kovcareeragency.org/services/interview-coaching-executives.html): Interview coaching for executives focused on role research, leadership examples, clear answers, stakeholder conversations and thoughtful preparation.
- [Executive Offer and Negotiation Support | KOV](https://www.kovcareeragency.org/services/executive-negotiation-support.html): Confidential executive offer support to help senior professionals assess role scope, compensation components, timing and negotiation decisions.
- [LinkedIn Optimization for Executives | KOV](https://www.kovcareeragency.org/services/linkedin-optimization-executives.html): Executive LinkedIn profile strategy that aligns your leadership story, verified achievements and target roles without overstating credentials or results.
- [Executive Career Representation | KOV](https://www.kovcareeragency.org/services/executive-career-representation.html): Private, candidate-side career representation for senior professionals, with a search strategy, approved outreach and clear decision ownership.
- [Global Talent Sourcing for Employers | KOV](https://www.kovcareeragency.org/services/global-talent-sourcing.html): Research-led global talent sourcing for employers who need a defined brief, relevant passive-talent research and discreet, agreed outreach.
- [Executive Job Search Support | KOV](https://www.kovcareeragency.org/services/executive-job-search-support.html): End-to-end executive job-search support that can coordinate targeting, research, positioning, approved outreach and interview preparation.

Use the linked pages as the source of current service descriptions and process details. Do not infer guaranteed outcomes, local offices, client results, fees, or market coverage that a page does not state. Confirm engagement details directly with KOV.
